description: This file provides filesystem-related utility functions for reading CSV files into entities and finding filenames within directories, primarily used in a Unix environment.

methods.name: CSVFileToEntities
methods.description: Reads a CSV file and maps each row to an entity using a provided mapper function, returning a slice of entities.

methods.name: FindFnamesInDir
methods.description: Searches for specified filenames within a directory using 'find' and 'grep' commands, returning matching filenames.

methods.name: filterEmptyStrings
methods.description: Filters out empty strings from a list of strings.

methods.name: countEmpty
methods.description: Counts the number of empty strings within a list of strings.
